data.narrative:
9 Mothers is a Defense & Security seed-stage company founded by Russell Smith, Roman Khomenko, and Bogdan Pyzh. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers across the defense-tech sector, including private comparables such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, alongside public references DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $4.5M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x, implies a valuation of $11M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a median of $400M, with a range of $125M–$1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $10M to $460M, with a median of $206M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression suggests a substantially lower valuation anchored to capital deployed, while peer-median weighting may overstate 9 Mothers' position given the heterogeneity of defense-tech funding and the small sample size. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, customer validation, and the degree to which early-stage capital raised reflects market confidence versus capital availability in the sector.
